mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment exceeding 100k (annualized) signals robust labor market conditions and corporate hiring momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k (annualized) over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market health, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.25 percentage points and CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.5% signal aggressive monetary tightening amid accelerating inflation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.4% triggers equity sell-offs due to inflation fears, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts exceeding 5% from the prior month signals weakening consumer demand and reduced construction activity, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where HOUST falls > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% from the prior month indicates manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where INDPRO falls > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.3% signal robust consumer demand expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 0.3% and HOUST rises > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST rise > 0.3% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor markets (UNRATE < 3.5%), a monthly payroll growth exceeding 150k signals overheating conditions that may prompt aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS rises > 150.
